title: Hoover Dam Discovery Kayak Tour with Lake Mead Views
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Paddle three scenic miles through the Lake Mead National Recreation Area for rare water-level views of both the Hoover Dam and the Mike O’Callaghan–Pat Tillman Memorial Bridge. Along this guided adventure, you may spot bighorn sheep, wild burros, eagles, and other desert wildlife while learning about the dam’s fascinating history from your expert guide. With space limited for an intimate experience, and all equipment provided, this is an ideal way to immerse yourself in the natural and engineering wonders just outside Las Vegas.
